questions.cardDe: In welcher Stadt erstrahlte Anfang des 20. Jahrhunderts die erste deutsche Leuchtreklame?
questions.de: In welcher Stadt erstrahlte Anfang des 20. Jahrhunderts die erste deutsche Leuchtreklame?
questions.en: In which city did Germany's first illuminated advertising sign light up at the beginning of the 20th century?

timeline.labelEn: Germany's first illuminated advertising sign, for Malton wine, is installed at Berlin's Spittelmarkt
timeline.labelDe: Die erste Lichtwerbeanlage Deutschlands, für Malton-Wein, entsteht am Berliner Spittelmarkt

questions.notes: The card's date is off: the first illuminated advertising in Germany went up in Berlin (Spittelmarkt) in 1896, i.e. the end of the 19th century. Even earlier, in 1853, glassblower Heinrich Geissler lit his name in a gas-discharge tube in his Bonn shop window; Berlin is the intended answer for commercial light advertising.

questions.cardDe: Welches Kiss-Bandmitglied sang auf der Hitsingle Beth?
questions.de: Welches Kiss-Bandmitglied sang auf der Hitsingle Beth?
questions.en: Which Kiss band member sang on the hit single Beth?

timeline.labelEn: Kiss release the single Beth, sung by drummer Peter Criss
timeline.labelDe: Kiss veröffentlichen die Single Beth, gesungen von Schlagzeuger Peter Criss

questions.notes: Beth is italic on the card. Drummer Peter Criss sang and co-wrote it (album Destroyer, 1976); release month from en.wikipedia Beth (song).

questions.cardDe: Das Frisbee trug ursprünglich den Namen „Pluto Platter“. Richtig oder falsch?
questions.de: Unter welchem Namen wurde die Wurfscheibe verkauft, bevor Wham-O sie „Frisbee“ nannte?
questions.en: Under what name was the flying disc sold before Wham-O named it “Frisbee”?

timeline.labelEn: Walter Frederick Morrison designs the Pluto Platter, the archetype of modern flying discs
timeline.labelDe: Walter Frederick Morrison entwirft den Pluto Platter, das Urbild aller modernen Wurfscheiben

questions.notes: True/false card (true) reworked. Morrison sold the rights to Wham-O on 23 January 1957; Wham-O renamed it Frisbee after hearing college students call it that.

questions.cardDe: Lionel Messi behauptete einmal von sich: „Ich bin der beste, zweitbeste und drittbeste Spieler der Welt.“ Richtig oder falsch?
questions.de: Wie oft wurde Lionel Messi, der Rekordgewinner, mit dem Ballon d’Or als bester Fußballer der Welt ausgezeichnet?
questions.en: How many times has Lionel Messi, the record winner, received the Ballon d'Or as the world's best footballer?

timeline.labelEn: Lionel Messi wins the Ballon d'Or a record eight times
timeline.labelDe: Lionel Messi gewinnt den Ballon d’Or als Rekordgewinner achtmal

questions.notes: True/false card about a boastful quote, presumably false (Messi is known for modesty); no fetched page attributes this quote to anyone, so the question was reworked to the verifiable fact behind it — Messi as the world's best player: Ballon d'Or record winner, eight times between 2009 and 2023.
